title: Name Change, Date Change and Administration Amounts Recorded Against Each Package Product
content:
The amounts the revenue office records for changes to a package sold under Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products are set out below. They are per traveller except where the schedule says otherwise, and each is read against the product the package was booked under.

| Product | Departure date may be moved | Date change per traveller | Most date changes permitted on one package | Replacing a member of the party, per traveller | Name change deadline, in calendar days before departure | Administration charge on any other amendment, per traveller |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | no | 0.00 USD | 0 | 95.00 USD | 14 | 45.00 USD |
| Flex Bundle Package | yes | 95.00 USD | 2 | 75.00 USD | 10 | 35.00 USD |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | yes | 125.00 USD | 2 | 85.00 USD | 14 | 40.00 USD |
| Escorted Tour Package | yes | 150.00 USD | 1 | 125.00 USD | 21 | 50.00 USD |
| Ocean Cruise Package | no | 0.00 USD | 0 | 175.00 USD | 35 | 65.00 USD |
| Luxury Collection Package | yes | 0.00 USD | 4 | 0.00 USD | 7 | 0.00 USD |

## The same amounts put as questions the schedule answers

**What charge does the schedule record for moving the departure date on the Escorted Tour Package?** 150.00 USD for each traveller, and the product records that at most 1 such move is permitted on one package.

**What does the schedule record for a package booked under the Value Bundle Package, where the date may not be moved?** A date change charge of 0.00 USD and a ceiling of 0 moves; the product carries no date change charge because it carries no date change.

**Is any product in the range recorded at nothing throughout?** The Luxury Collection Package records 0.00 USD for a date change, 0.00 USD for replacing a member of the party and 0.00 USD as its administration charge, while still recording a ceiling of 4 date changes and a name change deadline of 7 calendar days.
